uncited: **Determine Stacking Direction:** Calculate the angle between the current viewing direction and the current stacking axis.
**Reorder Stacking (if necessary):** If the stacking direction changes (e.g., from y-axis to x-axis), the logical-to-physical mapping must be updated.
A tile in the new stacking order is rendered in a stripe-by-stripe fashion, consuming portions of tiles from the old stacking order.
**Write Access:** Write the interpolated value to the single texel corresponding to the current grid point in the physical 2D texture.
**Rendering:** Access tiles in front-to-back order by rendering object-aligned quadrilaterals.
Texture coordinates address the tile in physical memory.
